stem.text: The sum of the electrical currents into a point in a circuit is equal to the sum of the currents out of the point.

A.text: This is Kirchhoff's first law, which results from the conservation of charge.

B.text: This is Kirchhoff's first law, which results from the conservation of energy.

C.text: This is Kirchhoff's second law, which results from the conservation of charge.

D.text: This is Kirchhoff's second law, which results from the conservation of energy.
